mapper.select:
SELECT FROM attendance_rule_config r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.deleted_flag = 0
AND (r.rule_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR r.rule_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND r.active_flag = 1
ORDER BY r.active_flag DESC, r.rule_code ASC, r.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_rule_config ( tenant_id, rule_code, rule_name, standard_daily_minutes, standard_weekly_minutes, auto_break_enabled, auto_break_threshold_minutes, auto_break_deduct_minutes, night_work_start, night_work_end, rounding_unit_minutes, rounding_mode, monthly_overtime_alert_hours, yearly_overtime_alert_hours, paid_leave_reminder_enabled, active_flag, note, deleted_flag ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{in.ruleCode}, #{in.ruleName}, #{in.standardDailyMinutes}, #{in.standardWeeklyMinutes}, #{in.autoBreakEnabled}, #{in.autoBreakThresholdMinutes}, #{in.autoBreakDeductMinutes}, #{in.nightWorkStart}, #{in.nightWorkEnd}, #{in.roundingUnitMinutes}, #{in.roundingMode}, #{in.monthlyOvertimeAlertHours}, #{in.yearlyOvertimeAlertHours}, #{in.paidLeaveReminderEnabled}, #{in.activeFlag}, #{in.note}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_rule_config SET rule_code = #{in.ruleCode}, rule_name = #{in.ruleName}, standard_daily_minutes = #{in.standardDailyMinutes}, standard_weekly_minutes = #{in.standardWeeklyMinutes}, auto_break_enabled = #{in.autoBreakEnabled}, auto_break_threshold_minutes = #{in.autoBreakThresholdMinutes}, auto_break_deduct_minutes = #{in.autoBreakDeductMinutes}, night_work_start = #{in.nightWorkStart}, night_work_end = #{in.nightWorkEnd}, rounding_unit_minutes = #{in.roundingUnitMinutes}, rounding_mode = #{in.roundingMode}, monthly_overtime_alert_hours = #{in.monthlyOvertimeAlertHours}, yearly_overtime_alert_hours = #{in.yearlyOvertimeAlertHours}, paid_leave_reminder_enabled = #{in.paidLeaveReminderEnabled}, active_flag = #{in.activeFlag}, note = #{in.note}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_flag = 0
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.employee_no, e.employee_name, w.workplace_name, d.department_name, r.id AS rule_id, r.rule_name, wr.effective_start_date, wr.effective_end_date, wr.rule_note, r.monthly_overtime_alert_hours, r.yearly_overtime_alert_hours, r.paid_leave_reminder_enabled, COALESCE(m.overtime_minutes, 0) AS monthly_overtime_minutes, COALESCE(y.yearly_overtime_minutes, 0) AS yearly_overtime_minutes, COALESCE(y.yearly_paid_leave_days, 0) AS yearly_paid_leave_days FROM employee e LEFT JOIN workplace w ON w.id = e.workplace_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN employee_work_rule wr ON wr.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND wr.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN attendance_rule_config r ON r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND r.id = wr.rule_id AND r.deleted_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN attendance_monthly m ON m.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND m.employee_id = e.id AND m.year_month = #{yearMonth} AND m.deleted_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, employee_id, SUM(overtime_minutes) AS yearly_overtime_minutes, SUM(paid_leave_days) AS yearly_paid_leave_days FROM attendance_monthly WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND year_month >= #{yearStartMonth} AND year_month <= #{yearMonth} AND deleted_flag = 0 GROUP BY tenant_id, employee_id ) y ON y.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND y.employee_id = e.id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.id = #{employeeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE employee_work_rule SET rule_id = #{ruleId}, work_rule_type = #{workRuleType}, standard_daily_minutes = #{dailyMinutes}, standard_weekly_minutes = #{weeklyMinutes}, overtime_enabled = 1, night_work_enabled = 1, holiday_work_enabled = 1, effective_start_date = #{effectiveStartDate}, effective_end_date = #{effectiveEndDate}, rule_note = #{note} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId}
